newsitem.title: LATVIA: SALACGRIVA'95 IN H1 PROFIT OF 165,560 LATS.
newsitem.headline: SALACGRIVA'95 IN H1 PROFIT OF 165,560 LATS.

text.p: Salacgriva'95 cannery said on Friday that its half year profit came to 165,560 lats on net turnover of 2.44 million lats.
The company said in a statment that this was an increase from its 1996 first-half profit of 152,575 lats when it had turnover of 1.2 million lats.
Salacgriva'95's production costs were 2.14 million lats and administrative costs were 116,418 lats. Sales expenses were 5,913 lats.
The company said it had 83,436 lats of income from other business activities and paid 23,024 lats in interest, giving it a pre-tax profit of 241,470 lats.
Salacgriva had extraordinary income of 25,361 lats and extrordinary expenses of 35,285 lats resulting in an extraordinary loss of 9,924 lats.
The company's balance sheet total in the first-half was 1.81 million lats and its own capital was 1.11 million lats.
It has fixed assets of 797,431 lats and payments due worth 413,713 lats and credits of 671,442 lats.
